title: Lemongrass Chicken

ingredientGroups.title: Marinade (for 2 lb of meat)
items: 2 lemongrass stalks, outer stems removed and minced

steps: Remove the outer stalks of the lemongrass until only the tender white (or purple) stalk remains at the base.  Trim about 1 cm of the root and the upper green section of the stalk.  Finely mince the remaining root stalk then bruise using the back or flat of the knife.
Combine all marinade ingredients then add the chicken thighs.
